# Knowledge Network

> The author's personal website: a hand-maintained index of essays,
> interactive experiments, media servers, art, and data analysis —
> centred on space, time, perception, and scientific vision, often
> approached through contested questions.

Home: https://followorbounce.github.io/

## Sections

- Design & Experience — a paired system: the Dictionary of Design (112 art/design terms, "design of the external world") and the Dictionary of Inner Experience (77 emotion/mood/existential terms, "design of inner experience"), each illustrated by its own small reusable abstract-vector visual grammar rather than stock imagery. Dictionary of Design: https://followorbounce.github.io/dictionary-of-design/. Dictionary of Inner Experience: https://followorbounce.github.io/dictionary-of-inner-experience/

- Waves — Universal Waves (master index of every wave family in nature: mechanical, electromagnetic, matter, plasma, gravitational, chemical, biological, information, astronomical, plus the shared mathematics): https://followorbounce.github.io/universal-waves
  - Waves — sound, light, seismic motion, and matter waves: https://followorbounce.github.io/waves
  - Music Is Mathematics — string physics, harmonics, equal temperament, digital audio, radio, cosmic resonance, nine-tool audio lab: https://followorbounce.github.io/music-mathematics
  - Perception — visual and auditory illusions as evidence for the brain as an inference engine, not a recorder: checker-shadow and simultaneous-contrast lightness constancy, "the dress," the phi phenomenon, the missing fundamental, Shepard tones and the tritone paradox, McGurk/rubber-hand/sound-induced-flash cross-modal fusion, inattentional and change blindness, the cocktail-party effect, and Yanny/Laurel, each with a live Canvas or Web Audio demo and a References section of primary sources: https://followorbounce.github.io/perception-illusions
- Aerospace — spaceflight history and engineering. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/
- Maya Basics — Maya calendrical systems. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/Maya-Calendar/
- Machinery — heavy machinery explained through engineering, physics, and mathematics. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/machinery/. Heavy Machinery: The Blueprint (an interactive comparator ranking 20 real machines by height, weight, engine power, and load capacity, translating every figure into a human-scale equivalent): https://followorbounce.github.io/heavy-machinery-blueprint
- Radio & Electronics — Electronics (resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transistors, logic gates, and the 555 timer, building up to microcontrollers and a semiconductor-physics deep dive on the p-n junction; six interactive demos — an Ohm's law solver, a resistor color-code decoder, an RC charge/discharge curve, a transistor-switch animation, a logic-gate simulator, and a PWM duty-cycle demo): https://followorbounce.github.io/electronics. Radio Communications (frequency, modulation, propagation, spacecraft links, spectrum management; its SDR waterfall runs a real FFT off an opt-in microphone, with a synthetic test signal as the permission-free default): https://followorbounce.github.io/radio-communications. Arduino, ESP32 & Physical Computing: https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/cascade-physical-computing. Media Servers (generative art, real-time rendering, GLSL shaders, projection mapping, signal processing, TouchDesigner/Notch/openFrameworks ecosystem): https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers.
  - Media Servers II — a real compiled GLSL shader, 3D projection mapping, Gerstner ocean waves, Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, curl-noise flow fields, and every Universal Waves family mapped to a real rendering technique: https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers-shaders
  Also experiments and observations (planned).
- Instruments — Password & Passphrase Generator (client-side only, Web Crypto API, BIP-39 wordlist, no network calls): https://followorbounce.github.io/password-generator. SDR Waterfall & ITU Spectrum Explorer: https://followorbounce.github.io/radio-communications#waterfall-canvas. Live Cryptography Demo — SHA-256 & ECDSA: https://followorbounce.github.io/blockchain-infrastructure#crypto. Shader Lab — Reaction-Diffusion & Curl-Noise: https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers-shaders#reaction
- Audio synth — Patch Bay (a real, playable generative modular synthesizer — patch cables between oscillator, filter, LFO, envelope and sequencer modules via the Web Audio API, in the visual language of Pure Data/vvvv/TouchDesigner with a Teenage Engineering-style hardware interface; scopes can switch between oscilloscope and FFT spectrum-bar view): https://followorbounce.github.io/patch-bay. Signal Chain (a second Web Audio synth built on the opposite principle from Patch Bay: one universal in/out jack instead of typed audio/CV/trigger cables, so any of its nine pedal-style units — oscillator with FM input and a sub-octave output, a noise source with white/swell/strobe/beacon modes, twin Ryoji Ikeda-leaning precision-pulse generators that lock to a rhythm patched into them, a two-output crossover filter, drive, chorus, delay — can bypass, chain, split, or feed back into any other, guarded by a compressor and hard limiter on the master output; same wave/spectrum scope toggle): https://followorbounce.github.io/signal-chain. Pulse Train (the same universal-node principle as Signal Chain, aimed at precision/microsound synthesis instead of pedal-style effects — pure sine and impulse generators, true ring modulation, a bit-crusher with an audio-rate gate, and a stereo panner quantized into hard steps instead of a smooth sweep, in the minimal/glitch lineage of Ryoji Ikeda, Alva Noto, and the Raster-Noton label): https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train. Pulse Train II (a ten-unit rack in the same palette — Tone, Rhythm, Crush, Ring, and Field carried over from Pulse Train, plus a second Tone, a delay pushed toward infinite freeze instead of a decaying echo, a short-delay comb resonator, and a convolution reverb built from a synthesized impulse response instead of a room recording): https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train-ii. Pulse Train — Stage (the same ten-unit engine restyled flat and thin-lined after Pure Data/vvvv, plus two rave-style master effects inline on Output — a square-wave Gate that chops the whole mix between silent and full on a tempo-rate pulse, and a momentary Kill switch held rather than toggled; eight tuning presets set every knob and footswitch from real interval math — a 4 Hz unison beat, a 3:2 just fifth, the golden ratio, a four-partial harmonic stack, the equal-tempered tritone, the Pythagorean comma, critical-band roughness, a Fibonacci rhythm — plus keyboard shortcuts and a fullscreen Stage mode for live playing): https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train-stage. Pulse Train — Stage II (Stage's board with Drive and Shimmer ported in from Signal Chain, and all twelve units organized into four labeled groups — Sources, Character, Time, Master — instead of one long row; nine tuning presets including Driven Shimmer, which finally routes Tone II's long-unused main output through saturation into chorus): https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train-stage-ii. Node Database (every node in Pulse Train — Stage II explained three ways — the software DSP technique, the underlying math, and a real chip from a real manufacturer, mostly Texas Instruments, that would do the same job in physical hardware): https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train-node-database. Wave Lab — Mixer, Resonance & Light Explorer: https://followorbounce.github.io/universal-waves#lab. 9-Tool Audio Lab: https://followorbounce.github.io/music-mathematics#lab
- Video synth — five instruments sharing a color engine and a knob widget (assets/visual-synth-kit.js), hub at https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/: Palette Synth (a live cosine-gradient color instrument — twelve knobs across three RGB channels, offset/amplitude/frequency/phase per channel, generate a full smooth palette in real time via color(t)=a+b·cos(2π(c·t+d)); its "Plasma" preset reproduces the same palette recipe already hard-coded in the plasma shader on Media Servers II, with GLSL/JS export): https://followorbounce.github.io/palette-synth. Additive Wave Sculptor (eight-harmonic Fourier synthesis, playable as real audio via a Web Audio PeriodicWave built from the same coefficients): https://followorbounce.github.io/additive-wave-sculptor. Lissajous / Harmonograph Plotter (two axes, each a two-term sine sum, plotted against each other with an amplitude-decay knob for the classic harmonograph rosette): https://followorbounce.github.io/lissajous-plotter. Audio-Reactive Reaction-Diffusion (the Media Servers II Gray-Scott chemistry, now driven by live sound — bass/treble bend feed/kill rates, loud moments seed new blooms; opt-in microphone, synthetic source by default): https://followorbounce.github.io/audio-reactive-diffusion. Complex-Plane Fractal Mapper (Mandelbrot/Julia explorer, z→z^power+c, colored with Palette Synth's own formula; drag the picture to pan or set the Julia constant): https://followorbounce.github.io/complex-fractal-mapper
- Research & Method — The Verification Field Manual (a practical handbook for finding, verifying, and preserving information across the web, historical internet, academic archives, public records, and scientific literature — source evaluation, search-engine internals, web archives, a full directory of scientific databases by field, OSINT method, and research ethics): https://followorbounce.github.io/field-manual. Blockchain Infrastructure (distributed systems, consensus mechanisms, cryptography, smart contracts, DAOs, tokenization, neutral/non-speculative, with real crypto.subtle hashing and ECDSA sign/verify demos): https://followorbounce.github.io/blockchain-infrastructure
- Philosophy — Consciousness — Humanity as Functional Consciousness: https://followorbounce.com/p/humanity-as-functional-consciousness. Reality & Perception — The Closed Door: https://followorbounce.com/p/the-closed-door. Free Will — Signal & Noise: https://followorbounce.com/p/signal-noise. Nature of Time and Ethics (planned).
- Personal — notes, travel stories, ideas, books and references, useful tools, archive (planned).
